purpose: Central-bank S/p balances with separate fund product net subscriptions and funding-market observations; underlying equity exposure direction is unmeasured; no asset performance model
scalar_definition: S=bank reserves+H.4.1 RRP Others, USD billion; two central-bank liabilities, not all-market liquidity
allocation_definition: p=(R/S,P/S); exact within-pool midpoint decomposition of reserve change, not overall liquidity conditions; p_R approaches 1 as P approaches zero and is fixed at 1 when P=0
equity_definition: F_US=Domestic Equity investment-objective mutual fund net cash flow+ETF net issuance value, ICI weekly estimate. Product subscriptions, including in-kind issuance, not whole-stock-market net cash flow or measured underlying equity exposure direction.

scope.label_ko: 광의 주식·일부 펀드 지분의 부문별 거래
included: Domestic financial/nonfinancial corporate equity, including both listed and closely held corporations.
ETF, closed-end-fund and REIT shares included in the corporate-equities instrument category.
U.S. residents portfolio purchases of foreign corporate equity and foreign investment fund shares, including ADRs.
excluded: Open-end mutual fund shares are a separate instrument; purchases of those fund shares are not added here.
Direct investment equity (cross-border ownership of10% or more) is a separate instrument.
Revaluation gains/losses and other volume changes; no changes of stock balances substituted for transactions.
not_measured: Pure U.S. exchange-listed operating-company stock cash inflow.
A destination-linked gross cash transfer matrix or stock-market cash accumulation.
Look-through sector allocation of ETF/CEF shares and underlying stocks.
Source of the bank deposit or reserve funds used by each buyer.
Gross trading volume, gross new issuance, buybacks alone, or asset-price effects.
scope.domestic_nonfund_issuance: Derived total minus ROW issuance minus ETF and CEF issuance. This narrows issuer scope only; it does not remove ETF/foreign exposures from each holder series. Still includes closely held corporations, REITs and financial companies.
scope.household_quality: Households and nonprofits are residually computed from total and other sectors, not an independent direct survey of retail buying.
scope.foreign_direction: ROW asset acquisitions are purchases of U.S. issues by foreign residents. ROW issuance is U.S. residents purchases of foreign issues and foreign investment funds. Neither is a U.S.-listed-stock-only series.
scope.fund_overlap: Fund portfolio equity purchases and investor purchases of fund shares are distinct layers. Do not add to each other or to ICI domestic-equity fund flows as one cash total. ETF issuance can involve in-kind creation.
scope.coverage_change: Use stable source series IDs across table renumbering. The August2026 preview introduces future changes; no preview data or new sector assumptions are mixed with the actual June11 release.

Fund subscriptions do not identify ultimate underlying stock purchases or exposure direction; domestic-equity mutual fund categories include long/short, market-neutral, leveraged and inverse strategies.
Domestic Equity is a fund investment objective, not precise exchange-level trade geography; World Equity includes Global funds that may invest in U.S. equities.
Z.1 includes fund shares, foreign shares and closely held equity; households are a residual estimate.
